name: @w6w-apps/strava
description: Read and log activities, comments, kudos and athlete stats on Strava.

w6w.longDescription:
Strava brings an athlete's activity data into a workflow — reading and logging activities, comments, kudos and stats. Activity actions list an athlete's activities, read one in detail, create a manually-logged activity, and update an existing one's details, alongside reading the comments and kudos left on a specific activity and the effort zones it was recorded in.

Athlete actions read the connected athlete's own profile and their aggregate stats — recent, year-to-date and all-time totals across their sport of choice. Because Strava's access tokens are short-lived, refreshing happens automatically behind the scenes so a scheduled workflow keeps working hours or days after the original connection.

This app deliberately does not cover file-based activity uploads (a separate multipart flow), or Strava's segments, routes, clubs and gear resources, focusing instead on the read-and-log loop around individual activities and an athlete's own stats.
